source: Union City Municipal Code Title 18 Zoning Ordinance, ecode360.com/UN5025; Union City Residential and Commercial Zoning Districts Development Standards, unioncityca.gov/208/Planning

RS-6000.description: Single Family Residential - min lot area 6,000 sq ft (7.26 du/ac); one principal dwelling plus one ADU per lot; max height 30 ft

RS-4500.description: Single Family Residential - min lot area 4,500 sq ft (9.68 du/ac); one principal dwelling plus one ADU per lot; max height 30 ft

R-5000.description: Single Family Residential - min lot area 5,000 sq ft (8.71 du/ac); one principal dwelling per lot; max height 30 ft; 50-60% lot coverage

RS-6000-H.description: Single Family Residential Hillside - min lot area 6,000 sq ft (7.26 du/ac); hillside development standards apply

RS-6000D.description: Single Family Residential Duplex - min lot area 6,000 sq ft (7.26 du/ac); allows duplexes

RS-3000.description: Single Family Residential Small Lot - min lot area 3,000 sq ft (14.52 du/ac); small-lot single-family

RM-3500.description: Multi-Family Residential Medium - min site area 3,500 sq ft per unit (12.45 du/ac); max height 30 ft

RM-2500.description: Multi-Family Residential Medium-High - min site area 2,500 sq ft per unit (17.42 du/ac); max height 30 ft

RM-1500.description: Multi-Family Residential High - min site area 1,500 sq ft per unit (29.04 du/ac); max height 75 ft

511.description: 511 Area District - special single-family residential district; standards similar to R-5000

CMU.description: Corridor Mixed Use - min 17 du/ac, max 45 du/ac; min site area 968 sq ft per dwelling unit; mixed-use along corridors

VMU.description: Village Mixed Use - mixed-use village center; 17-30 du/ac

MMU.description: Marketplace Mixed Use - mixed-use marketplace; 17-30 du/ac

SEMU-R.description: Station East Mixed Use Residential - high-density residential near BART station; 25-60 du/ac

CPA.description: Commercial Pedestrian Activity - pedestrian-oriented retail and services; min site area 5,000 sq ft; max lot coverage 50%; max height 100 ft; no residential

CN.description: Neighborhood Commercial - small-scale retail and neighborhood services; min site area 5,000 sq ft; max height 30 ft; no residential

CC.description: Community Commercial - broad range of retail and service commercial; min site area 5,000 sq ft; max height 100 ft; no residential

CVR.description: Commercial Vehicle Related - auto-related commercial uses; min site area 5,000 sq ft; max height 100 ft; no residential

CS.description: Commercial Service - service-oriented commercial; min site area 5,000 sq ft; max height 40 ft; no residential

ML.description: Light Industrial - light manufacturing and warehousing; no residential

MG.description: General Industrial - general manufacturing and industrial uses; no residential

P.description: Public Facilities - public and institutional uses; no residential

OS.description: Open Space - parks, recreation, and open space; no residential

511 Area District.description: 511 Area District (GIS alias). Maps to 511 special single-family residential district. Standards similar to R-5000.

511 Area District - Open Space.description: 511 Area District - Open Space (GIS alias). Open space portion of the 511 Area District. No residential.

Agricultural.description: Agricultural (GIS alias). Agricultural land use. Residential not a primary permitted use.

Civic Facility.description: Civic Facility (GIS alias). Maps to P (Public Facilities). Government and institutional uses. No residential.

Community Commercial.description: Community Commercial (GIS alias). Maps to CC (Community Commercial). Broad range of retail and service commercial. No residential.

Coorridor Mixed Use.description: Corridor Mixed Use (GIS alias, misspelled variant). Maps to CMU. Min 17 du/ac, max 45 du/ac.

Corridor Mixed Use.description: Corridor Mixed Use (GIS alias). Maps to CMU. Min 17 du/ac, max 45 du/ac.

Corridor Mixed Use Commercial.description: Corridor Mixed Use Commercial (GIS alias). Maps to CMU. Mixed-use along corridors. Min 17 du/ac, max 45 du/ac.

Corridor Mixed-Use Employment.description: Corridor Mixed-Use Employment (GIS alias). Employment-focused corridor mixed-use. Residential not a primary use.

Decoto Residential.description: Decoto Residential (GIS alias). Maps to RS-6000 single-family residential in the Decoto area. Max 7.26 du/ac.

Light Industrial.description: Light Industrial (GIS alias). Maps to ML (Light Industrial). Light manufacturing and warehousing. No residential.

Market Place Mixed Use.description: Market Place Mixed Use (GIS alias). Maps to MMU (Marketplace Mixed Use). 17-30 du/ac.

Multi-Family Residential.description: Multi-Family Residential (GIS alias). Maps to RM-1500/RM-2500/RM-3500. Density up to 29.04 du/ac depending on subdistrict.

Neighborhood Commercial.description: Neighborhood Commercial (GIS alias). Maps to CN. Small-scale retail and neighborhood services. No residential.

Open Space.description: Open Space (GIS alias). Maps to OS. Parks, recreation, and open space. No residential.

Private Institutional.description: Private Institutional (GIS alias). Private institutional uses (schools, churches, etc.). No residential.

Professional and Administrative Commerci.description: Professional and Administrative Commercial (GIS alias). Maps to CPA (Commercial Pedestrian Activity). No residential.

Single Family Residential.description: Single Family Residential (GIS alias). Maps to RS-6000. Single-family homes. Max 7.26 du/ac.

Single Family Residential, DIPSA.description: Single Family Residential, DIPSA (GIS alias). Single-family residential within the DIPSA overlay. Max 7.26 du/ac.

Single Family Residential/Special DIPSA.description: Single Family Residential/Special DIPSA (GIS alias). Single-family residential with special DIPSA designation. Max 7.26 du/ac.

Special Industrial.description: Special Industrial (GIS alias). Maps to MG (General Industrial). Industrial uses. No residential.

Station East Employment.description: Station East Employment (GIS alias). Employment-focused district near BART station. No residential.

Station East Mixed Use Residential.description: Station East Mixed Use Residential (GIS alias). Maps to SEMU-R. High-density residential near BART. 25-60 du/ac.

Station Mixed USe Commercial.description: Station Mixed Use Commercial (GIS alias, misspelled variant). Commercial mixed-use near BART station. No residential.

Station Mixed Use Commercial.description: Station Mixed Use Commercial (GIS alias). Commercial mixed-use near BART station. No residential.

Union Landing Commercial.description: Union Landing Commercial (GIS alias). Commercial uses at Union Landing shopping area. No residential.

Village Mixed Use Commercial.description: Village Mixed Use Commercial (GIS alias). Maps to VMU (Village Mixed Use). 17-30 du/ac.

Vistor and Recreation Commercial.description: Visitor and Recreation Commercial (GIS alias, misspelled). Maps to CVR. Commercial vehicle/visitor-related uses. No residential.
